# Dental Webinars & Events


Thriving practices are always evolving. By leveraging the right technology and forging strategic partnerships, you can improve patient care, elevate experiences for both patients and staff, and expand your patient base. We're here to guide you at every step. Join our webinars and events for practical insights that will empower your practice to reach new heights.


Webinar Spotlight


## 4 Smart Tips to Streamline Billing, Speed Up Payments, and Boost Cash Flow


Your practice is a business—and running it well means having systems that make the money part less of a headache. In this session, we’ll show you how to simplify billing, streamline payments, and reduce the daily chaos that slows you down.


[Watch Now](https://www.henryscheinone.com/insights/webinars-and-events/smart-practice-series/tips-to-streamline-billing/)
